newsitem.title: CHINA: China Resources, CKI to join Hang Seng Index.
newsitem.headline: China Resources, CKI to join Hang Seng Index.

text.p: China Resources Enterprise Ltd and Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd will join the Hang Seng Index, replacing Oriental Press Group Ltd and Johnson Electric Holdings Ltd, HSI Services Ltd said.
The reshuffle will take effect from July 31.

After the changes, the market capitalisation of the Hang Seng Index is expected to account for 70 percent of total market capitalisation compared with a current 68-69 percent, HSI Services spokesman Tony Chiu said.
HSI Services is the compiler of the Hang Seng Index.
It said it would also make changes to its Hang Seng MidCap 50 Index on July 31, adding Oriental Press Group, Johnson Electric, Goldlion Holdings Ltd and Henderson China Holdings Ltd.
HSI Services said it would remove China Resources, Pudong Development Holdings Ltd, Sing Tao Holdings Ltd and Stelux Holdings International Ltd from the Hang Seng MidCap 50 Index.
It said the index is expected to account for about nine percent of total market capitalisation.
Oriental Press Group and Johnson Electric will also be removed from the Hang Seng London Reference Index, leaving the index with 27 constituents.
"China Resources and Cheung Kong Infrastructure must be traded on SEAQ International before we can add them (to the Hang Seng London Reference Index)," said Chiu.
